```sql
WITH RECURSIVE tainted(fid) AS (
  SELECT fl.src FROM fact_links fl
  JOIN sources s ON s.id = fl.dst
  WHERE fl.kind = 'DERIVED_FROM' AND s.uri LIKE '%02_api_style_guide_v1%'
  UNION
  SELECT fl.src FROM fact_links fl
  JOIN tainted t ON fl.dst = t.fid
  WHERE fl.kind = 'DERIVED_FROM'
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.text
FROM decisions d
JOIN decision_facts df ON df.decision_id = d.id
WHERE df.fact_id IN (SELECT fid FROM tainted);
```
